name: mdh-fanout-matches-to-selectable-table
summary: Fan all MDH match options into a multivalue table with a per-row select flag, hash-guarded; maintain a filtered export list of the selected keys.

source_match_field.description: MDH match enum field holding ALL matched options (value + label)

hash_source_field.description: captured field whose value gates recompute (the match input); extend the hash string if matching on several keys

hash_field.description: hidden field storing the recalculate hash — preserves operator selections across recomputes

target_table.description: multivalue table to populate, one row per match

row_key_field.description: hidden per-row column = option.value (the export/PATCH key)

row_select_field.description: per-row yes/no enum the operator ticks; default no for >1 matches, yes for a lone match

export_list_field.description: hidden list of row_key values where select==yes; hand to an export iterate_over

provenance: DESIGN-STAGE, unproven: handbook solutionarchitecthandbook.mrtnzlml.com/cookbook/multiple-data-matching-results (fan-out + hash guard) + a field spec for multi-order call-up updates (subset-select flag + filtered export). Not yet live-validated.
notes: Composes with export-iterate-line-items (point its iterate_over at export_list_field). Keep-ALL-with-flag, never prune rows — selections stay auditable and non-destructive. iterate_over has no inline filter, so it must be handed the pre-filtered export_list_field. Block >1 matches with a separate add_automation_blocker rule. CANDIDATE: verify the TxScript option .value/.label attributes and multivalue write shape against txscript-reference and a live soft re-fire before promoting to standard.
